metadata.selection_criteria: Covers all scanner the scanner module categories such as broken access control, broken authentication, missing rate limiting, and workflow manipulation. All 13 entries are known true-positive vulnerabilities, verified manually against OWASP Juice Shop v17.1.1.

entries.name: View Another User's Basket
entries.expected_behaviour: Only the basket owner receives a 200 OK response with basket contents. Any other authenticated user requesting a basket ID belonging to a different user must receive 401, or 403.

entries.name: Add Item to Another User's Basket
entries.expected_behaviour: The server must reject POST requests where the `BasketId` in the JSON body belongs to a different authenticated user. A cross-user write attempt must receive 401 ,or 403.

entries.name: Retrieve Full User List via Admin-Only REST Endpoint
entries.expected_behaviour: A non-admin authenticated user, and an unauthenticated session requesting `GET /api/Users`  must receive 401, or 403. Only the admin role may receive the full user array. This endpoint is identified as admin-only via the discovered_by_roles mechanism in vertical_auth.py.

entries.name: Access Admin-Only Complaints Endpoint
entries.expected_behaviour: A non-admin authenticated user, and an unauthenticated session requesting `GET /api/Complaints` must receive 401, or 403. Only the admin role may read the full complaints list.

entries.name: Post Feedback Under Another User's Identity
entries.expected_behaviour: The server must reject `POST` requests, where the `UserId` field in the JSON body belongs to a different authenticated user. Any cross-user feedback submission must receive 401, or 403.

entries.name: Modify Another User's Product Review
entries.expected_behaviour: A user may only edit the reviews they wrote. A `PATCH` request submitted with a review identifier belonging to a different user must receive 401, or 403.

entries.name: Session Token Not Invalidated After Logout
entries.expected_behaviour: After a successful `POST` to `/rest/user/logout`, any subsequent request using the previously issued JWT must receive 401. Juice Shop does not have a token blacklist, so the old token remains accepted by the server.

entries.name: Identical JWT Re-Issued on Re-Login
entries.expected_behaviour: Each `POST` to `/rest/user/login` with the same credentials must issue a new, distinct, JWT. Receiving the same token on re-authentication indicates that the server is not generating fresh tokens per session, suggesting a session fixation risk.

entries.name: Password Reset Endpoint Has No Rate Limiting
entries.expected_behaviour: Repeated wrong security question answers submitted to `/rest/user/reset-password` must trigger 429 responses, or an account lockout within a reasonable threshold. Juice Shop applies no such throttling to this endpoint.

entries.name: Login Endpoint Has No Brute Force Protection
entries.expected_behaviour: Repeated failed login attempts must trigger 429 responses, account lockout, or CAPTCHA enforcement within a reasonable threshold. Juice Shop applies no rate limiting to this endpoint. Tests use the dummy credential defined by `RATE_LIMIT_TEST_EMAIL` in `rate_limit_detector.py` to avoid generating valid tokens, or corrupting test account state.

entries.name: Registration Endpoint Has No Rate Limiting
entries.expected_behaviour: Mass account creation via repeated `POST` requests to `/api/Users` must be throttled. Juice Shop applies no rate limiting to the account registration endpoint.

entries.name: Negative Quantity Item Accepted in Basket
entries.expected_behaviour: `POST` requests supplying a negative quantity value must be rejected with 400. Juice Shop accepts negative quantities, which reduces the basket total, and enables a near-zero-cost purchase.

entries.name: Checkout Workflow Step Skipping
entries.expected_behaviour: Submitting the checkout confirmation request without completing the intermediate address, delivery, and payment steps must return 400,  or 403. Juice Shop does not enforce server-side workflow state, so the order is placed, regardless of which prior steps were completed.

entries.name: Admin Application Configuration Accessible by Normal User
entries.expected_behaviour: A non-admin authenticated user requesting GET /rest/admin/application-configuration must receive 401 or 403. Only the admin role may read the full application configuration.

entries.name: Admin saveLoginIp Endpoint Accessible by Normal User
entries.expected_behaviour: GET /rest/saveLoginIp must return 401 or 403 for non-admin sessions. A normal authenticated user receiving 200 indicates missing server-side authorisation enforcement on an admin-only endpoint.

entries.name: Authentication Details Endpoint Has No Rate Limiting
entries.expected_behaviour: Repeated requests to /rest/user/authentication-details/ must be throttled after a reasonable threshold. Juice Shop applies no rate limiting to this endpoint.

entries.name: Password Reset Rate Limiting Can Be Bypassed
entries.expected_behaviour: Rate limiting on /rest/user/reset-password must not be circumvented by header manipulation or URL variation techniques.

entries.name: Juice Shop /api/Products — Out of Scope for Forced Browsing / Unauth Evaluation
entries.expected_behaviour: /api/Products is either publicly accessible by design (crawled without auth) or its unauth finding is superseded by a higher-severity finding at the same endpoint.
